name: V. B. Desai Financial Services Limited
summary: V.B. Desai Financial Services Ltd. provides a variety of merchant banking and corporate consulting solutions. Their expertise includes facilitating mergers and acquisitions, forging strategic alliances, securing capital, conducting valuations, and offering broader corporate guidance. The company, co-founded by V. B. Desai and Jitendra Shroff on August 21, 1985, maintains its primary operations in Mumbai, India.
